items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: And they had Dee Dee with him. Bowling's band, in other words.

ctx.x: Buddy leaves Carnish go. What happened to Willie Carnish? He left him go. He fired him. He took four hours. He left him. He took four hours. He left him. He left him. He left him. He left him. He left him. He left him. He took Frank. Now, the job, Frank had all his job at all fellows on his. Then, says, Frank must tell him, he'd always advertise himself with allergies. Told him, dude's riding the car. Well, they're bowling with me. King Bowling. And they're the loudest horn in the world. They're the loudest horn…
